en: AZ
Hm? A young Trainer, out on the old landing. Not many walk this far.
I am called AZ. I was a king, once. A very long time ago.
My land was at war, and I could not stop it. So I built a machine that could. A weapon, the greatest ever made.
It ended the war. It also took the life of a small Floette who had been my dearest friend.
I could not bear it. I gave my own life to the machine to find her. I have waited here, in one form or another, ever since.
They tell me you have walked all of Kalos and stood in the Hall of Fame. You have shown that Pokémon and people can be strong together.
I would like to see it for myself. Not a weapon. A bond. Show me!
Ah... yes. That is what I forgot. Power is not what the war was missing. It was this.
Thank you, {player}. Perhaps the long wait has been worth it. Take these, with an old man's thanks.
Some days I sit here and listen to the sea. It does not ask for anything. I am learning from it.
{rival}
{player}! I came out on the first train. Kiloude's the end of the line, so I knew you'd turn up here sooner or later.
Champion, huh? I'm not jealous. Much. But I haven't stopped chasing you. Battle me!
{rival}
Still the Champion. All right. I'll keep training up here, where the wind off the sea is strong.
Take this. I found it on the beach, of all places. It's a Mega Stone, for an Absol. It'll do more good with you.
Oh, and the professor rang. He wants to meet you by the sundial in Anistar City. Something about your Key Stone.
I won? I won! Come back when you're ready. I'm not going anywhere.
Another battle? I train up here every day.
{rival}
Same time tomorrow?
Whenever you like. The sea's not going anywhere, and neither am I.
That's enough for one day. Come back tomorrow, and I'll be stronger!
